rationale: Four separately made components (fried eggplant, boiled eggs, tahini sauce, chopped salad) score components 2. Batch shallow-frying is intermittent attention (1) and a shallow-fry technique (1); eggs boil in parallel (coordination 1). The total of 6 is the lowest involved score, the same level as Spiced Lamb Meatballs (6). (Thai Basil Eggplant Stir-Fry is not a comparator here: its final D-03 ruling is moderate 5 [1,2,1,1,0].) WAVE proposed moderate; the rubric gives involved because of the component count, not because of cuisine.
